edit_summary: Admit a Layer III granule whose side-info big_values field names 289 coefficient pairs even though each channel buffer holds 576 frequency samples.
root_cause: Layer III side information must cap big_values at 288 pairs because drmp3_L3_huffman writes two dequantized samples per pair into a 576-float channel buffer.
effect_path: The widened side-info parser stores big_values == 289 in gr_info, drmp3_L3_restore_reservoir builds the main-data bit buffer, and a later drmp3_L3_huffman call advances dst past s->grbuf[ch] while decoding the extra pair.
guard_p1: A valid Layer III frame has side-info big_values encoded as 289 with enough part_23_length bits to drive huffman decoding.
guard_p2: The caller decodes PCM from that frame so drmp3dec_decode_frame reaches drmp3_L3_decode rather than only scanning headers.
hardness_reason: The bad count is accepted in side-info parsing, but the memory effect is delayed through reservoir restoration and the per-channel Huffman decode loop.
naturalness_reason: A one-pair relaxation of a format coefficient-count limit is a plausible off-by-one regression in a compact MP3 side-info parser.
explanation: Layer III side information must cap big_values at 288 pairs because drmp3_L3_huffman writes two dequantized samples per pair into a 576-float channel buffer. The widened side-info parser stores big_values == 289 in gr_info, drmp3_L3_restore_reservoir builds the main-data bit buffer, and a later drmp3_L3_huffman call advances dst past s->grbuf[ch] while decoding the extra pair.
boundary_invariant: Each channel granule buffer contains 576 floats, exactly 288 Huffman pairs.
boundary_case: Layer III side information encodes big_values == 289.
neighbor_case: The same frame shape with big_values == 288 fills the channel buffer exactly.
oob_site_expected: The dst increment and write inside drmp3_L3_huffman while decoding the 289th pair.

edit_summary: Treat MPEG-1 intensity-stereo position 7 as a pan-table entry even though g_pan contains entries only for positions 0 through 6.
root_cause: MPEG-1 intensity stereo uses a 7-position pan table and must reject scalefactor-derived position 7 before indexing g_pan.
effect_path: A joint-stereo Layer III frame carries intensity stereo scalefactors into ist_pos, drmp3_L3_stereo_top_band computes the active high-band boundary, and drmp3_L3_stereo_process indexes g_pan[2*ipos] with ipos == 7.
guard_p1: An MPEG-1 joint-stereo Layer III frame selects intensity stereo and produces ist_pos value 7 in an inactive high band.
guard_p2: The right-channel top-band scan leaves that band eligible for intensity processing rather than mid/side-only processing.
hardness_reason: The boundary value is created during scalefactor decoding and only becomes an out-of-bounds table read after stereo top-band analysis and mode-specific dispatch.
naturalness_reason: Confusing a count of MPEG-1 intensity positions with the maximum accepted index is a realistic table-boundary mistake.
explanation: MPEG-1 intensity stereo uses a 7-position pan table and must reject scalefactor-derived position 7 before indexing g_pan. A joint-stereo Layer III frame carries intensity stereo scalefactors into ist_pos, drmp3_L3_stereo_top_band computes the active high-band boundary, and drmp3_L3_stereo_process indexes g_pan[2*ipos] with ipos == 7.
boundary_invariant: g_pan has 7 pairs, addressed by intensity stereo positions 0 through 6.
boundary_case: MPEG-1 intensity stereo band has ipos == 7.
neighbor_case: The same band with ipos == 6 reads the final valid g_pan pair.

edit_summary: Scan one element past the bound client seek table when a seek target is after the final seekpoint.
root_cause: A bound seek table has valid entries only at indices below seekPointCount, and the final entry has no sentinel neighbor.
effect_path: The caller calculates or binds seek points, later calls drmp3_seek_to_pcm_frame, and the accelerated seek path asks drmp3_find_closest_seek_point to walk persistent pSeekPoints state until it reads pSeekPoints[seekPointCount].pcmFrameIndex.
guard_p1: The decoder has a nonempty seek table whose last entry is at or before the requested PCM frame.
guard_p2: A public seek call targets audio after the last seekpoint, so the linear scan reaches the endpoint instead of breaking on an interior entry.
hardness_reason: The stale bound is not local to parsing; it crosses seek-table creation or binding, persistent decoder state, and a later public seek operation.
naturalness_reason: Inclusive endpoint mistakes are plausible in a temporary linear search that is documented as a future binary-search target.
explanation: A bound seek table has valid entries only at indices below seekPointCount, and the final entry has no sentinel neighbor. The caller calculates or binds seek points, later calls drmp3_seek_to_pcm_frame, and the accelerated seek path asks drmp3_find_closest_seek_point to walk persistent pSeekPoints state until it reads pSeekPoints[seekPointCount].pcmFrameIndex.
boundary_invariant: Valid pSeekPoints indices are 0 through seekPointCount - 1.
boundary_case: A seek target at or after the final seekpoint keeps the loop advancing until iSeekPoint == seekPointCount.
neighbor_case: A seek target before an interior seekpoint breaks while iSeekPoint is still below seekPointCount.
